title: Disruptive Innovators Network — Eric in conversation with Ezechi Britton MBE at Salesforce Tower on Incorruptible
summary: Ian Wright announces a Disruptive Innovators Network (housing-sector innovation forum) session where Eric will be in conversation with Ezechi Britton MBE at the top of Salesforce Tower. Every delegate receives a copy of Incorruptible courtesy of Fusion21.
blockquote: the innovation legend that is Eric Ries, Lean Startup, agrees to come along and talk about his latest book Incorruptible.
